About This Spot

Tucked into Adams Avenue, Maya Moon Collective is a cacao cafe and community space built around slowing down. The menu runs on organic cacao sourced from South America, seasonal ingredients from local farmers, and a house rule of zero refined sugar, so everything from the ceremonial drinking cacao to the pastries and savory bites is naturally sweetened and handcrafted in house.

Beyond the counter, the space doubles as a gathering point for Normal Heights, hosting bi-monthly art installations, makers markets, moon meditations, and evening workshops. If you're looking to discover their ceremonial cacao experiences or see what community events are coming up, the offerings are there, they just deserve a clearer path to find and book them, which is exactly what a dedicated listing helps solve.
